newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's Bolger has no intention of stepping down.
newsitem.headline: NZ's Bolger has no intention of stepping down.

text.p: Prime Minister Jim Bolger said on Monday he had no intention of stepping down when the cabinet is reshuffled in two years.
"I'm certainly not planning to go in two years," he told National Radio.
Since the election there has been speculation that Bolger will be replaced before the next election.
Bolger said he found it remarkable that after almost 11 years as leader of the National Party, commentators continued to write articles every six months saying he was going.
